title: Umgxothwa Emyezweni
intro: Isidalwa esingaqondakaliyo sasikhe sahlala kwiindawo eziphakamileyo zendalo, sisondele kuThixo kunokuba abaninzi babenokukuqonda. Kodwa ke ikratshi laqala ukukhula, kwaye isenzo esinye sokungathobeli satshintsha indlela yokuphila. Ngoku, esi sidalwa sihambahamba njengotshaba olufungelweyo, sihleba kwaye senza amacebo de kufike umhla othenjisiweyo. Ungamtyhila na lo uwileyo?
clues: Ndandingomnye wabo basondeleyo kubukho bukaThixo, ndiphakanyisiwe ngaphezu kwendalo yonke.
Ndadalwa ngento etshayo, kungekhona ngomhlaba okanye ngodongwe.
Xa ndayalelwa ukuba ndiqubude phambi kwesidalwa esitsha, ndala — ndiqhutywa yinto endandikholelwa ukuba ndingcono kakhulu.
Ndagxothwa ndaza ndaqalekiswa, kodwa ekugqibeleni ndanikwa ithuba lokuphumla de kwafika ixesha elaziwayo nelimiselweyo.
Ndafunga ukuba ndiza kulahlekisa abaninzi kangangoko ndinako, ndisondela kwinzala ka-Adam evela macala onke.
Ndingutshaba oluvulekileyo nolubhengeziweyo loluntu lonke, ndisoloko ndiceba kwaye ndihleba kude kube sekupheleni okumiselweyo.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all (15:39)
